headline: Police inspector withdrawn for allegedly raping 12-year-old in Noakhali
summary: Khorshed Alam, OC of Jahazmara Police Investigation Centre, was removed from duty after the victim and her mother shared their allegations on Facebook Live.
details: A police inspector in Noakhali's Hatia Upazila has been withdrawn from duty following allegations that he raped a 12-year-old child. Khorshed Alam, the officer-in-charge of the Jahazmara Police Investigation Centre, was attached to the district police lines after the case gained attention on social media.
The victim alleged on Facebook Live that Inspector Khorshed called her to his house under the pretext of sweeping, while her mother was working as a cook at the police center, and raped her.

The child's mother claimed that she and her son were threatened with jail time if they spoke out. She further alleged that local intermediaries obtained their signatures on a white sheet of paper and promised action that never came.

The mother also alleged that she had previously complained to the Hatia Circle Police Officer, but no action was taken. She claimed she has been unable to return home for four months due to the situation.
Hatia Police Station chief Mohammad Kabir Hossain stated that a previous verbal complaint was investigated by the Hatia Circle ASP and found no truth to the claim at the time.
Following the Facebook Live statement on Saturday, the police inspector was withdrawn. Station chief Kabir confirmed that the matter will be investigated further and appropriate action will be taken.

The child's mother claimed that she and her son were threatened with jail time if they spoke out. She further alleged that local intermediaries obtained their signatures on a white sheet of paper and promised action that never came.

The mother also alleged that she had previously complained to the Hatia Circle Police Officer, but no action was taken. She claimed she has been unable to return home for four months due to the situation.

Hatia Police Station chief Mohammad Kabir Hossain stated that a previous verbal complaint was investigated by the Hatia Circle ASP and found no truth to the claim at the time.

Following the Facebook Live statement on Saturday, the police inspector was withdrawn. Station chief Kabir confirmed that the matter will be investigated further and appropriate action will be taken.

headline: Enforced disappearance case: Witnesses to testify against Sheikh Hasina and 16 others today
summary: A court is set to record witness testimonies in a case involving allegations of enforced disappearances and torture.
details: A court is scheduled to take witness testimonies today in a case involving allegations of enforced disappearances and torture.
The case names former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and 16 other individuals as the accused.
The proceedings are part of a legal effort to address claims of state-sponsored disappearances and torture during the previous administration's tenure.
The court will examine the evidence and testimonies provided by witnesses to determine the the legal standing of the case against the accused.
